state_mapping: The six-digit code's department prefix, agreeing with DANE codes, mapped explicitly to ISO (e.g. 05 -> ANT, 08 -> ATL, 76 -> VAC); 22 old links corrected
consumer_consequence: Colombia retains 3,672 official full-code IDs and their re-derived department links, corrects 22 links, queues 4 absent codes, and keeps locality labels and points null.
product: 4-72 official postal code shapefile (Unidad Código Postal Colombia)
credit: Fuente: MINTIC-Servicios Postales Nacionales 4-72 (Unidad Código Postal Colombia)
note: Only codes and their department prefixes are used; locality names and points stay empty. The datos.gov.co portal table (CC BY-SA 4.0) was a check only.
